links.outcome: LLM accuracy on medical MCQs across input question languages and prompt languages
links.effect: Accuracy ranged 64%-87%; input language effect significant (P<.01), best on German; English prompts generally better than language-matched, though top models showed comparable results.
links.quote: The effect of input question language was significant (P<.01) with models performing best on German questions.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM-generated answer explanations to identify insufficiently precise exam questions in medical education

screen.reason: The study empirically tests LLMs on multilingual medical MCQs and evaluates the effect of prompt language strategy (English vs. language-matched prompts) across different input languages on performance.
